dict.string: Cadence uses the Meta AI Glasses and iPhone microphone for voice check-ins after a suspected fall, vocal volume tracking, and the Guided Home Motor Exam.
Cadence uses on-device Apple Speech recognition to listen for "I'm okay" or "Help" during the 12-second post-fall safety check-in even when offline.
Cadence maintains a continuous Bluetooth connection to your Meta Gen 3 AI Glasses for Freeze-of-Gait rhythmic auditory cueing and fall detection.
Cadence attaches your GPS coordinates to caregiver SOS alerts only when a fall is confirmed.
Cadence attaches your GPS coordinates to caregiver SOS alerts if a fall occurs while the app is running in the background.
Cadence reads iPhone motion to detect freezing of gait and falls when the glasses motion stream is not available.
